name: lsimons-template
comment:vite: vite is an *optional peer* of vitest, so pnpm auto-installs it: it
appears in no manifest, `pnpm update` and `pnpm dedupe` both report
'already up to date' because no importer declares it, and dependabot
cannot see it at all. 1b617aa cleared its advisories by re-resolving
the whole lockfile, which fixed that instance but not the mechanism —
nothing would move it the next time it drifts. Declaring it here makes
it a managed pin. Keep the range inside vitest's peer range (^8.0.0).
